summary: The school district emphasizes the critical role of E-Rate funding in maintaining essential services and access to broadband connectivity for libraries and schools. The school district opposes any sunset or limitation of E-Rate funding, arguing that it is essential for providing reliable internet access, digital literacy training, and technology support to the community.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate funding, libraries will have to cut core services to maintain internet service
claims.evidence_quote: When E-Rate began in the late 1990s, most libraries and schools had little or no internet access. Today, libraries and schools across the nation have reliable internet access year after year because of E-Rate. Without E-Rate funding, we will have to cut core services, programs, and operations to maintain the internet service our community requires
